# Microsoft 365 Copilot Governance Overview

Microsoft Sentinel provides correlation, visualization, investigation routing, and operational health. Microsoft Purview, Defender, Entra, Microsoft 365 reporting, and Global Secure Access remain authoritative. Missing Sentinel data does not mean that no risk or compliance activity exists.

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| summarize Sources=count(), Healthy=countif(Status == "Healthy"), Stale=countif(Status == "Stale"), UnavailableOrSilent=countif(Status == "UnavailableOrSilent")
content.title: Native source coverage and health

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| project TableName, Status, LastEventTime, ExpectedFreshness, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute, RequiredForMvp
| order by RequiredForMvp desc, Status asc, TableName asc
content.title: Control ownership and native routing
